text:
maya: heads up — I'm planning a change to the runtime config API to allow per-route telemetry sampling (sample_percent). need feedback on safety model and console UX before i open the PR

ali: quick q — is this just for telemetry export sampling or also for enabling feature-flag rollouts?

maya: primarily telemetry to reduce cardinality & cost, but we want it to be deterministic so we can do stable cohorts for rollouts too (so same request consistently in/out).

tom: agree deterministic is key. use hashing algorithm on stable key (user_id or client_id). otherwise metrics will be noisy and rollout analysis lies.

ali: ok. for API shape, propose:
```
PATCH /v1/configs/:id
{ "routes": [{"path": "/completion","sample_percent": 5, "sample_key": "user_id"}]
}
```

ali: sample_percent 0-100, integer. sample_key optional; default to request_id if absent (but request_id isn't stable across clients).

maya: i'd prefer default to client_id for hosted API, but we need to expose this per-deployment. also need server-side check that sample_key exists in request context, otherwise reject the config (fail-fast).

tom: and document behaviour: hash(user_id) % 100 < sample_percent. please choose fn consistent across lang SDKs — e.g. fnv1a32 then modulo.

maya: good call. we should include deterministic hashing spec in API docs.

sre-oncall: operational concern — sampled telemetry affects alerting thresholds and SLOs. if we under-sample, paging noise may drop. need a telemetry-gate flag that prevents critical alerts from being sampled out.

ali: yes. Proposed safety: any metric flagged "slo=true" or alerts with severity >= P1 should be forced sample_percent=100 irrespective of route sampling. That should be enforced by sandboxed server-side merge.

tom: we also need to worry about quotas and billing. If sampling reduces telemetry tokens, that's okay, but request-level quota should not be affected by telemetry sampling. Clarify in API: sampling only affects telemetry export, not routing/quota decisions.

maya: adding to spec:
- sampling only impacts telemetry export and internal metrics collection
- routing/quotas/auth unaffected
- config validation rejects sample_key if not present in known context

ali: console UX question — slider vs numeric input for percent. slider is nice but we should show exact cohort size and an example hash formula so PMs can reason. maybe slider + numeric + "preview sample" button that seeds some example ids and shows which would be included.

tom: +1 preview. Also require a dry-run mode on rollout where sampled telemetry is duplicated to a shadow sink (no effect on live alerts) so data analysts can validate without changing production alerting.

maya: technical note: dry-run duplicates export, adds cost. default dry-run retention short. We'll add a flag: "dry_run": true, and server returns estimated additional bytes per minute.

sre-oncall: we need audit trail: sample_percent changes must be immutable records with who/why and previous value. console should show changelog with links to runbooks.

maya: agreed. Implemented as config versions. +1 on runbook links.

ali: another API detail — how to roll forward safely: we should support incremental ramp stages: e.g. [1,5,10,25,50,100] with time windows. Server should orchestrate and update routing telemetry flag gradually. Minimal API example:
```
PATCH /v1/configs/:id
{ "routes": [{"path":"/completion","sampling_ramp": {"stages": [1,5,10], "stage_duration_minutes": 30}}]
}
```

tom: server-side ramp orchestration ok, but must be idempotent and crash-recoverable. i.e. store current stage and next-stage timestamp in config metadata so restarts don't re-run timers.

maya: good catch. also need an endpoint to abort ramp and immediately set sample_percent to X.

sre-oncall: telemetry gating again — when ramping up, alerts might trigger at different sensitivities. Recommend a "telemetry-safety-mode" that temporarily routes critical metrics to both sampled and full pipeline for N minutes after each step and compares. If divergence > threshold, auto-pause ramp and notify oncall.

ali: that's heavy but safe. we can make it opt-in per-ramp. console should surface expected divergence and last run diffs.

maya: on config schema validation: reject configs that attempt to set sample_percent > 0 for routes that have sla=true. We should add a metadata field "slo_exempt": true on route definitions that prevents sampling.

tom: for implementation, runtime must expose stable sampling function plugin so dedicated/private deployments can override hash function for compliance. Ensure API allows "hash_namespace" optional string for determinism across deployment clusters.

maya: security note — ensure sample_key does not cause PII leakage in logs. the preview tool must hash preview ids client-side and not store raw ids.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: config-service v2.5 -> canary 1% @ 2234568200, full rollout v2.5 @ 2234569900.

maya: thanks bot. action items: 1) ali/ux: design slider + numeric + preview + changelog UI 2) tom/eng: add deterministic hashing fn, ramp orchestration metadata, abort endpoint 3) oncall: define telemetry-safety-mode thresholds and runbook 4) maya: draft API spec + docs for sample_key, dry-run, slo_exempt, hash_namespace 5) ali: mockups for preview privacy (client-side hashing)

ali: i'll put mockups in the design doc and link.

tom: i'll start a PR for server side and include a small compatibility test harness showing distribution stability across versions.

sre-oncall: i'll write the runbook for ramp abort + divergence checks. please @me on PR for telemetry-safety-mode logic.

maya: cool. i'll open the API RFC tonight and drop the link here. :thumbsup:
